Hi Alex / Redwood team,

Thanks — this is a good starting set. For AWS Marketplace co-sell verification we usually need the following as a minimum:

- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted okay) + SOC 2 bridge letter if the report is older than 12 months
- Penetration test letter or attestation signed by the testing vendor (indicating scope and date)
- Executed DPA or DocuSign-ready DPA (we accept redlines, but final must be executed)
- Contact for security point-of-contact (name + email + phone) for the marketplace intake form

Optional but helpful for healthcare:
- Statement about data residency / regional hosting (us-east-1 / us-west-2)
- Any HIPAA compliance notes or BAAs if you plan to handle ePHI (Marketplace review will flag if customer requires it)

Two quick notes:
1) We do prefer the pen-test letter to explicitly call out the scope and confirm it covered internet-facing APIs and the inference endpoints. A notarized affidavit is not required but a vendor-signed attestation with scope language is.
2) Upload the artefacts to the secure intake link below and paste the HubSpot deal ID when you submit so it ties to the co-sell request.

Upload link: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/intake/upload
Checklist (attached): aws-marketplace-checklist.pdf

If you want, I can open the co-sell intake ticket now and link BeaconHealth; need the HubSpot deal URL or the procurement contact.

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Ops
